claims.text: A 49-year-old man was involuntarily admitted to a psychiatric hospital after a failed suicide attempt. Examination showed depressed mood, anhedonia, fatigue, loss of self-confidence, self-blame without delusional depth, persistent suicidal ideation, concentration problems, terminal insomnia and loss of appetite, most present for 3 weeks. No bipolar, recurrent depressive or personality disorder features were present.
